xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5289: Workflow redesign B: Files/Changes/Search dock replaces the explorer tab; global shortcuts; Go to file ranking

plan.title: Workflow redesign B: Files/Changes/Search dock replaces the explorer tab; global shortcuts; Go to file ranking
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The file explorer is a Stage tab: opening it hides the conversation, nothing shows what a conversation changed, Go to file ranks by a fuzzy score that often puts the exact file low, the palette cannot find files, and a separate floating conversation dock covers the page. Child B of the PAN-5284 workflow redesign moves all of this into one dock beside the chat.
narratives.Proposal: Mount a WorkDock inside the Command Deck Stage beside the pane area with Files, Changes, Search and Live tabs whose scope follows the active Stage tab (deriveDockScope). Files hosts the existing explorer (ExplorerFiles) with tree polish, ignored files hidden, a View options menu, a root menu and a changed-here dot; Changes reads child A's /changes API, explorer git status and the project changes API with a diff view built on the extracted PatchFiles renderer; Search wraps ContentSearch; Live is the former floating dock. Four global registry shortcuts, the + menu, project Home and issue overview Files buttons open it; persisted files panes migrate into it. Go to file ranks by match tier on the server and boosts changed-here files on the client; the Ctrl K palette gains a Files scope through a mounted-dock registration. An isolated-dashboard Playwright spec covers the entry points and takes the NFR screenshots. A root override belongs to the tab that was active when it was set (rootOverrideAnchor), so tab changes never need to clear it.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Conversation header Changes/Files buttons, status line and per-turn card (children D1 and D2); B only provides openDock
- Code pane breadcrumb, File/Changes toggle, Reveal button, gutter marks, editor bar, Create PR dialog and stale-tab handling (child C)
- Any change to components/Stage/PaneBar.tsx, tab sizing, the 'N tabs' list or shortcut labels on the + menu (child D2)
- Any new or changed server route, and any change under packages/contracts; the only server file is src/dashboard/server/services/explorer/search.ts
- Per-line mine/others marking inside a diff (the API returns a count only)
- A committed-file diff for edit-workspace roots
- A Live surface on pages that have no Stage; those pages keep the Needs-you strip
- Global Files shortcuts on pages without a Stage (Ctrl+P keeps the browser default there)
- Mobile-specific dock layout and Ledger theme parity beyond not breaking
- Adding the isolated Playwright spec to CI's test:playwright list
- Raising any scripts/file-size-allowlist.txt row
- Coloured per-language file badges (style guide forbids hex brand colours)

metadata.sizeJustification: Child B of the PAN-5284 epic, already split from the epic by the operator's order book. Parent decision D-13 requires that the PR removing the explorer Stage tab ship the dock and every entry point together, so the dock shell, the files-pane migration and the entry points cannot ship as separate issues without leaving the dashboard without an explorer. The surface is wide because each tab owns its own small module and test file; the 29 items are vertical slices that fan out in parallel after four foundations (dock store, scope, shell, changes hook) and two early pure modules (file match, changes model).

autoDecisions.summary: Keep child B as one issue with sizeJustification (B-D1)
autoDecisions.rationale: The order book already split the epic and D-13 ties removing the files tab to shipping the dock.

autoDecisions.summary: Dock opens files with openBeside, not revealPane (B-D3)
autoDecisions.rationale: revealPane with a non-leaf beside id replaces the active region, which is the chat; openBeside (shipped by S) keeps the chat visible.

autoDecisions.summary: Global Files shortcuts exist only while a Stage is mounted; E and G toggle, F focuses, P opens (B-D4)
autoDecisions.rationale: The dock lives in the Stage (D-2); outside it there is nothing to open, so the browser default is the least surprising behavior.

autoDecisions.summary: The palette learns the mounted dock through a small zustand registration (activeDock) (B-D5)
autoDecisions.rationale: CommandPalette is mounted in App.tsx outside every StageDeckProvider; App.tsx is not B-owned beyond removing the floating dock.

autoDecisions.summary: Ranking tiers on the server, changed-here re-rank and highlight on the client, one shared case table (B-D6)
autoDecisions.rationale: The server cannot know the scope and contracts are not B-owned.

autoDecisions.summary: Uncommitted diffs are HEAD vs working tree built with parseDiffFromFile from two explorer reads (B-D7)
autoDecisions.rationale: diffs/full diffs from the conversation start commit, so it is not a not-committed diff; parseDiffFromFile renders with the same FileDiff component.

autoDecisions.summary: useConvoDock 'expanded' becomes the request to show the Live tab (B-D9)
autoDecisions.rationale: Callers on pages without a Stage keep working unchanged and the item appears the next time a deck mounts.

autoDecisions.summary: A code pane takes its changes source from the first conversation leaf in the split (B-D10)
autoDecisions.rationale: The pane a file was opened beside is not stored anywhere; the layout already says what is beside it.

autoDecisions.summary: Neutral file icons with monospace extension labels (B-D13)
autoDecisions.rationale: The mockup badges use hardcoded brand hex colours, which the style guide forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: The isolated Playwright spec is run locally by the work and test roles, not added to CI (B-D14)
autoDecisions.rationale: It seeds git repositories and boots a built dashboard; CI e2e is already flaky (#5298).
changelog.d/README.md requires the lowercase issue id; the child stub said 5289.md.

autoDecisions.summary: Root overrides are anchored to the pane active when they were set instead of being cleared on tab changes (B-D17)
autoDecisions.rationale: A clearing effect would fire during the files-pane migration (closing the active files pane changes the active pane) and wipe the override it just set; a derived anchor needs no effect.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-1, §6.3, B-D5, B-D9. In components/dock/workDockStore.ts: add 'live' to DockTab and DOCK_TABS; add searchPath?: string to OpenDockInput and DockState; add openSeq: number to DockState (starts 0, incremented by every openDock, never persisted); openDock clears searchPath when the input has none; add transient quickOpen: boolean with setQuickOpen(deckKey, open) (never persisted); add toggleTab(deckKey, tab): when the deck is open and its tab equals tab -> closeDock, else openDock({ tab }). Persistence stays { open, tab, width } only. Create components/dock/activeDock.ts exporting interface ActiveDock { deckKey; rootId: string | null; changedPaths: ReadonlySet<string>; openFile(path); revealFile(path) } and useActiveDock = create<{ current: ActiveDock | null; set(d: ActiveDock | null): void; clear(deckKey: string): void }>, where clear only nulls current when current.deckKey === deckKey. Neither file imports any components/Stage module. B-D17: add transient rootOverrideAnchor?: string to DockState (never persisted) and change setRootOverride to setRootOverride(deckKey, rootId, anchorPaneId?): it stores both; rootId undefined clears both. ActiveDock also carries activePaneId: string | null.
